Using a RPI or a Old Computer you can hook up a proxy->VPN for your whole house.

Reasons:

  1. A lot of devices (Ex.Consoles) solely allow you to connect to a basic proxy or don't support OpenVPN.

  2. Most VPN providers prevent their customers from using more then a couple connections at once.

  3. Enables you to use a proxy on a single program on your computer. (Ex. Using a internet browser with a VPN while also using steam without a VPN.)

Materials:

  1. Raspberry Pi or Old computer Ex.RPI Zero you may also want to buy a kit to cover the network connection.

  2. VPN provider of your choosing Ex.Airvpn

Setup:

  1. Install the necessary server software on your device. Ex.RPI

  2. Install OpenVPN and Privoxy to your device

  3. Copy the OpenVPN certs from your VPN provider to your device

  4. (Optional) Install a Addblock Addon to Privoxy

  5. Make sure Privoxy is running and start OpenVPN in a screen session on your device.

Connecting: Your IP will be the local IP of the device and the port will be 8118

  1. For your internet browsers use a proxy connection addon Ex.FoxyProxy

  2. For your consoles, use your systems proxy setting.
